title: | Auto Collect Drop Money, Food Critic
script:
local plr = game.Players.LocalPlayer
local chr = plr.Character or plr.CharacterAdded:Wait()
local root = chr:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart")
game:GetService("StarterGui"):SetCore("SendNotification", {
    Title = "67 Mango Mustang",
    Text = "Are Loading...",
    Duration = 5
})

--FDF
local dropfile = workspace.DropFolder
if not dropfile then
    game:GetService("StarterGui"):SetCore("SendNotification", {
        Title = "ERROR",
        Text = "DropFolder not found!",
        Duration = 5
    })
    return
end

-- Sccf
function collectCoins()
    local coins = dropfile:GetChildren()
    
    for i = 1, #coins do
        local coin = coins[i]
        if coin and coin:IsA("Part") then
            root.CFrame = coin.CFrame
            wait(0.2)
        end
    end
end

while true do
    collectCoins()
    wait(5)
end
